name: Chokehold Blow
description: Step off the back foot and drive the lead fist straight into the opponent's chest or jaw.

name: Fistdash
description: Turn the hips and throw the rear fist across the guard to land on the cheek.

name: Snug Heelbone
description: Raise both forearms to cover head and ribs and take the blow on the bone.

name: Shifting Fist
description: Shift head and front foot off the line of a punch and set up the counter.

name: Descending Hip
description: Swing the rear shin into the outside of the opponent's thigh.

name: Turning Shoulder
description: Seize the opponent's collar and elbow together and pull them off balance into close range.

name: Locking Pinfall
description: Slide both arms under the opponent's arms and crush the chest in a tight lock.

name: Pushing Sweep
description: Drop low and snatch the opponent's front ankle to topple them backward.

name: Folded Ulna
description: Throw the hips back to smother a leg grab and spin around to the opponent's back.

name: Throwstay
description: Thread an arm under the opponent's arm and press on the neck to roll them over.

name: Sideways Throw
description: Bridge the hips and slide out from under a pinning weight to free the legs.

name: Gnawing Shin
description: Drive the heel of the hand up under the chin to snap the head back.

name: Lowered Palm
description: Slap an incoming punch aside with the flat of the palm and keep the hand ready.

name: Gnawing Grapple
description: Shove with both palms into the chest to knock the opponent off their feet.

name: Folded Knuckle
description: Lift an open palm under a falling blow and let the forearm take the weight.

name: Shindash
description: Swing the blade of the hand down onto the side of the neck or collarbone.

name: Ulnablow
description: Plant the standing foot and push the ball of the other foot into the opponent's belly to stop an advance.

name: Firm Palm
description: Whip the rear leg around with the hips so the shin lands on the ribs.

name: Elbowdash
description: Pull the opponent's head down by the collar and drive the knee up into the body.

name: Settled Knee
description: Lift the shin to meet a low kick edge-on and let the bone absorb it.

name: Light Sweep
description: Step the rear foot away to leave the opponent's kick short of its mark.

name: Knee Cowl
description: Hook the heel behind the opponent's ankle and pull the leg out to drop them.

name: Sharp Fist
description: Stamp the heel down on the top of the opponent's foot to pin it and stun them.

name: Pulling Chokehold
description: Pull the opponent's arm over your hip and lift them across the back to the ground.

name: Clinchwedge
description: Step beside the opponent and sweep their standing leg out while pushing the chest back.

name: Grapple Stay
description: Load the opponent across the shoulders and drop to one knee to slam them down.

name: Kept Elbow
description: Rotate the wrist against the thumb of a gripping hand to tear its hold off the sleeve.

name: Tight Hip
description: Widen the feet and sink the hips so a throw against you finds no purchase.

name: Catching Elbow
description: Land beside the thrown opponent and hold their shoulder to the floor with a straight arm.

name: Settled Shin
description: Tuck the chin and slap both arms flat to the floor as the back lands.

name: Resting Knuckle
description: Roll across the shoulder and onto the hip so a sideways throw ends in a safe landing.

name: Skipping Shoulder
description: Tuck and roll over one shoulder to come up on the feet facing the opponent.

name: Elbowtrot
description: Kick the legs overhead from the back and snap the hips up to land standing.

name: Sweepdodge
description: Curl on the side and push with the feet to slide clear along the floor.

name: Hooding Knee
description: Lie on the back with knees raised and forearms up so the opponent's strikes find no target.

name: Throwskitter
description: Turn from lying on the stomach to a low kneeling stance in one movement.

name: Hippace
description: Sit through under an opponent's reach to turn the body and escape their weight.

name: Flat Grapple
description: Exhale sharply as the lead fist lands so the blow carries a little circulating qi.

name: Snug Ulna
description: Hold the breath for one beat and tense the arms to harden the guard against a strike.

name: Short Heelbone
description: Throw two quick jabs on a single breath to find the range and disturb the guard.

name: Light Chokehold
description: Slide the feet in a low stance without lifting them so balance stays under a push.

name: Hiphit
description: Snap the fist back along the line of the punch to follow with another strike.

name: Backward Throw
description: Pace footwork to slow breathing so stamina holds through a long exchange.

name: Leaden Clinch
description: Whip the point of the elbow across the jaw from inside the opponent's reach.

name: Clinch Bump
description: Lift the elbow sharply under the chin as the opponent leans in.

name: Kneebump
description: Dip and drive the shoulder into the chest to break the opponent's stance.

name: Fiststrike
description: Fall the point of the elbow onto the collarbone of a bent opponent.

name: Solid Shoulder
description: Tuck the elbows in front of the ribs and face to turn a barrage aside.

name: Fist Pace
description: Turn on the ball of the foot to leave the opponent's close attack behind.

name: Blunt Sweep
description: Sweep an elbow behind to strike an opponent who grips from the rear.

name: Fixing Pinfall
description: Lock both hands behind the opponent's neck and drag the head down to the chest.

name: Ulnastay
description: Clasp the hands around the waist and heave the opponent's feet off the ground.

name: Sweepstrike
description: Hold the head tied and drive knees up into the body in quick succession.

name: Ulnaamble
description: Pull the opponent's arm across their body and step past it to their side.

name: Lowered Ulna
description: Set both forearms against the opponent's chest and press to open a gap.

name: Hooding Shin
description: Roll the palm over the wrist of an incoming punch and carry it wide.

name: Hard Hip
description: Plant and drive the heel of the hand into the floating ribs with a small push of qi.

name: Tight Knuckle
description: Press the opponent's lead hand down with the palm and step off the line of attack.

name: Flat Elbow
description: Strike both palms to the chest one after the other to stagger the opponent backward.

name: Ulnalid
description: Flick the open hand at the eyes to draw the guard up before the real strike.

name: Palmhop
description: Slide forward behind a lead palm to close the distance without a gap.

name: Solid Palm
description: Raise the hand to turn a punch away from the head and keep the line clear.

name: Lowered Elbow
description: Sweep the forearm down across the body to knock a kick aside.

name: Quick Knee
description: Catch the incoming fist against the shoulder and send a short punch straight back.

name: Sideways Clinch
description: Drop beneath a swinging fist and hook a punch to the body on the way up.

name: Planted Hip
description: Draw the arms into a tight shell and back away while the blows land on the forearms.

name: Palmbump
description: Meet an advancing opponent with a low kick that stops the step at the knee.

name: Shifting Shoulder
description: Hop the feet back out of range to start the exchange again from safe ground.

name: Smooth Heelbone
description: Watch the opponent's shoulder line to see the strike before the fist leaves the guard.

name: Kneepause
description: Drop the hips and drive forward under the opponent's guard to take both legs.

name: Turning Shin
description: Hug one leg to the chest and rise to tip the opponent over onto their back.

name: Shinpause
description: Press the forearm across the jaw of a downed opponent to pin the head and shoulders.

name: Throwlid
description: Lie across the chest at right angles and spread the weight to keep them flat.

name: Towing Ulna
description: Peel the gripping hand from the sleeve and hold the wrist to the floor.

name: Shindodge
description: Slide the knees up the sides of the body to settle high on the chest.

name: Planted Knuckle
description: Arch the back and roll sideways to throw off the rider and reverse the position.

name: Tripping Palm
description: Pull the head down by the collar to bend the opponent's spine and ruin their stance.
